detected_takeover: PPC Guru-managed campaigns (prefixed 'PPC -') began delivering in July 2026. Account-level and campaign-level monthly pulls across 2022-2026 returned data only for July 2026, indicating the account launched / began active delivery under PPC Guru in July 2026.
notes: Meta returns metric values as formatted strings (e.g. 'CA$496.25 CAD', '17,444', '0.91%'); these were parsed to numbers.

THIN DATA: only one month of delivery exists (July 2026). There is no prior period to compare against, so this is a single-month launch snapshot, not a before/after story. Status set to 'Needs Review' and confidence 'Low' accordingly.

Genuine enquiries = 8 Instant-Form leads (campaign 'PPC - Sold by kaushik - Instant Form') plus 8 WhatsApp messaging conversations (campaign 'PPC - Sold by kaushik - Whatsapp'). Messaging conversations are reported honestly as conversations, separate from form leads.

Account-level cost_per_lead (CA$62.03) divides total account spend by the 8 form leads only and is therefore misleading; the form campaign's own CPL is CA$19.33. Blended cost across all 16 enquiries = 496.25 / 16 = CA$31.02.
No landing-page-view, placement or audience data was available from the account-level pull (returned 'Not available').
